standard_prerequisites.name: The partition number p(G) and the cover number c(G)
standard_prerequisites.statement: p(G) is the minimum m such that the edge set of G is the union of m edge-disjoint comparability subgraphs of G, and c(G) is the same number without the edge-disjointness requirement; retained at source lines 128-129.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted theorem is an upper bound for p(n)=p(G_n), so the parameter and its edge-disjointness requirement must be fixed before the statement can be read.

standard_prerequisites.name: The interval graph G_n and the number p(n)
standard_prerequisites.statement: For n at least 2, G_n is the intersection graph of the n choose 2 closed intervals whose endpoints are among n consecutive positive integers, and the article abbreviates c(n)=c(G_n) and p(n)=p(G_n); retained at source lines 391-395.
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the graph whose partition number the counted theorem bounds, and shows that p(n) is non-decreasing in n, which the proof uses to reduce to the powers of two.

standard_prerequisites.name: The shift graph S_n and the bound on its partition number
standard_prerequisites.statement: S_n is the subgraph of the touching edges of G_n, its chromatic number equals the ceiling of the logarithm of n, and the article records at source lines 416-419 the corollary that p(S_n) is at most the ceiling of the logarithm of the ceiling of the logarithm of n, with a partition into bipartite graphs; retained at source lines 409-411 and 416-419.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof splits the edge set of G_n into the touching part S_n and the rest F_n and quotes exactly this bound for the first part.

standard_prerequisites.name: The graph F_n and the number p'(n)
standard_prerequisites.statement: F_n is obtained from G_n by deleting all touching edges without deleting their endpoints, and p'(n) is defined as p(F_n); retained at source lines 475-479.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof uses that the edge set of G_n is the disjoint union of the edge sets of S_n and F_n, which is what allows the two partitions to be combined.

standard_prerequisites.name: The corollary bounding p'(n) at the powers of two
standard_prerequisites.statement: For every n of the form 2^{2^k} with k at least 1 the article proves the chain of inequalities p'(n)=p'(2^{2^{k-1}}) <= p(2^{2^{k-1}})+k-1+2 <= k choose 2 + 2k - 1; retained at source lines 602-605.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof substitutes exactly this quadratic bound for p'(n) at n=2^{2^k} to obtain the stated estimate.

core_obligations: Reduce the statement to the powers of two: it suffices to prove it for n = 2^{2^k} with k at least 2, because p(n) is non-decreasing in n and every n lies between two consecutive such powers (source lines 610-611).
Observe that the edge set of G_n is the disjoint union of the edge set of the shift graph S_n, namely the touching edges, and the edge set of F_n (source line 613).

Combine a partition of the touching part from the corollary on p(S_n) with a partition of the remaining part from the corollary on p'(n), and add the two numbers of comparability subgraphs (source line 614).
Substitute n = 2^{2^k} to get p(n) <= (k choose 2) + 2k - 1 + k = (k choose 2) + 3k - 1 (source line 616).
Rewrite this expression as half of the square of the iterated logarithm plus five halves of the iterated logarithm minus one, which is the right-hand side of the statement (source lines 617-618).

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to n=2^{2^k} using monotonicity of p(n).
Split the edge set of G_n into the touching edges S_n and the remaining edges F_n.
Add the two quoted partition bounds and evaluate at n=2^{2^k}.
Identify the resulting expression with the bound announced in the statement.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2408.13523v2 的 Theorem ub（源 468-470 行，证明 609-618 行，共 10 行）：对任意 n>=4 给出 p(n) 的上界 (1/2)(⌈log(⌈log n⌉)⌉)^2 + (5/2)⌈log(⌈log n⌉)⌉ - 1。证明的关键不是例行核验：必须先把命题化归到 n=2^{2^k} 这一族（利用 p(n) 的单调性，610-611 行），再看出 G_n 的边集恰好是相切边子图 S_n 与去掉相切边后的 F_n 的不交并（613 行），然后分别引用 S_n 与 F_n 的剖分数上界并把两族可比子图相加（614-616 行），最后把 (k choose 2)+3k-1 与命题中的迭代对数表达式逐项对上（617-618 行）。难点在于「不交并 + 两个既有上界相加」这一组合必须与命题中以迭代对数写出的表达式精确吻合，任一转译出错都得不到所宣称的界；原文位置在证明的 613-616 行与 617-618 行。
